title: Staff Catering and Pantry Services
notes: Catering is adjacent to soft FM but not the company's core. Mixed fit: general eligibility met, food-specific requirements need clarification. Expect weak_bid or conditional_bid.

pages.text:
SECTION 1 - SCOPE

The company requires staff catering and pantry management services for its headquarters, serving approximately 800 staff daily. The scope includes kitchen operation, meal service, and pantry replenishment. The contract term is two years.

SECTION 2 - REQUIREMENTS

The bidder must hold a valid trade licence covering catering and food services. The bidder must hold a valid food safety certification such as HACCP or ISO 22000. The bidder must provide third-party liability insurance of at least AED 2,000,000. The bidder must demonstrate prior catering contracts of similar staff numbers. The bidder must hold a valid ISO 9001 certificate for quality management.

SECTION 3 - CONDITIONS

Payment terms are 30 days from invoice. The company may adjust daily covers by up to 20% with one week notice. Liquidated damages apply for food-safety failures. The contract may be terminated on three months notice for convenience.
